$comment: THE ACTUAL VERDICT. Subjective playability, 1-10, scored by the repo owner after playing all eleven entries in the arena. This is the only measurement in this run that saw the games running. Everything else — the gate, the primitives, the judge panel — is either a floor or a proxy. Keyed by cell so it survives any reordering of the landing page.

findings.note: The anonymised judge panel did NOT predict playability. Its joint-highest entry scored 1/10; its lowest-ranked cell scored 8/10. The panel reads code and notes and cannot see a WebGPU game render, so it was measuring the persuasiveness of design rationale, not the game.
findings.conclusion: Run-to-run variance (up to 7 points) is roughly 4x the largest between-model difference (1.75). No model or harness conclusion in this run is distinguishable from noise. Two samples per cell was necessary and insufficient.
